units.source_text: 如果名人不知道今天要去箱根，那是无话可说的。

en.t: If the Master had not known that they were going to Hakone today, there was nothing more to be said.

units.source_text: 许多人聚拢在另一个房间里，走廊上人声嘈杂。

en.t: Many people had gathered in another room, and the hallway was noisy with voices.

units.source_text: 大竹七段长时间不露面。

en.t: Otake, seventh dan, did not appear for a long time.

units.source_text: 这期间，名人独自在座位上一动不动地等候。

en.t: During that time, the Master waited alone in his seat without moving.

units.source_text: 午饭时间稍稍推迟，问题终于获得了解决，

en.t: Lunch was delayed a little, and the problem was finally resolved,

units.source_text: 决定今天两点到四点对局，隔两天再到箱根去。

en.t: it was decided that they would play today from two to four, then go to Hakone two days later.
